description.value:
Duration as long as you choose

You can perceive through your Feral Bond's senses at any time, switching between its senses and your own freely and without spending an action. While perceiving through your Bond you are not deprived of your own senses; you receive both.

cinderfall.incomplete: Spot-checked directly against Summoner/Eidolon (the one real pf2e subsystem where two actor sheets are tightly linked): grep -rn "\"key\": \"Sense\"" pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/ class-features/summoner/*.json returns zero hits. Even that subsystem doesn't rule-encode cross-actor sense-sharing. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
